title: DAY 2/90
GATE ME
scenes.voice: Day two of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and nine days to GATE. Keep the streak alive.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Engineering Mechanics. Our topic: kinematics and dynamics.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover particle kinematics, relative velocity, plane motion of rigid bodies, and Newton's laws with D'Alembert's principle.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. For a wheel rolling without slipping, the contact point has zero velocity, and the top point moves at twice the centre's speed.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Your free practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Today's test is open from seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course, and the toppers come in the next reel.

scenes.title: Day 1 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day one toppers! Rank one, Sweta Rani Sahoo, with a perfect thirty out of thirty. Rank two, Shubham Kumar. Rank three, one R I A E M. Congratulations!
